name: command-08
description: A multi-select label picker that keeps the list open and shows chosen labels as badges.

"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Command, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandInput, CommandItem, CommandList, } from "@workspace/ui/components/command" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const labels = [ { id: "bug", name: "Bug", color: "bg-destructive" }, { id: "feature", name: "Feature", color: "bg-primary" }, { id: "docs", name: "Documentation", color: "bg-primary" }, { id: "design", name: "Design", color: "bg-primary" }, { id: "perf", name: "Performance", color: "bg-primary" }, { id: "security", name: "Security", color: "bg-primary" }, ] export default function MultiSelectLabels() { const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState(["bug", "perf"]) const toggle = (id: string) => setSelected((current) => current.includes(id) ? current.filter((item) => item !== id) : [...current, id] ) return (
{selected.length === 0 ? ( No labels applied ) : ( labels .filter((label) => selected.includes(label.id)) .map((label) => ( {label.name} )) )}
No labels found. {labels.map((label) => ( toggle(label.id)} > {label.name} ))}
) }
